name: kettlebell single arm sit up
description: A sit-up while holding a kettlebell overhead with one arm. It adds shoulder stability to an abdominal move.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a kettlebell held straight up in one hand.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and your arm locked.
Curl up and sit all the way to standing or upright.
Control your descent back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
